title: Single Incision Laparoscopic Surgery (SILS) Versus Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy
brief_summary: Prospective randomized trial of single incision versus standard 4 port laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Hypothesis is that the operative time will be longer with single incision.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Need for cholecystectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Need for cholangiogram
